title: Router Redesign QA
eyebrow: Ready for your test · built, and checked here and on GitHub's Windows machine

unverified: Real Claude Code has not run inside the terminal panel. Here I used a stand-in script that printed its arguments and echoed what was typed, because a real session would need a Claude login on this sandbox.

The panel has not run on Windows with a real screen. GitHub's Windows machine only checked that node-pty (the part that runs a program inside the panel) can start a program under the app's engine (Electron), because that machine has no desktop.
The quit prompt, which asks before the app closes while Claude Code is running, has not been clicked. It is a Windows dialog, and the test tool can't press its buttons.
The Older heading and the working-now dot from recent activity were only checked by unit tests, because the demo data has no session older than seven days or newer than 30 seconds
Files over 5 MB and the Show earlier button have not been opened in the session view
Your three accounts have not been tried. The app only finds Claude folders in your user folder whose names are .claude or start with .claude-, so check that all three accounts appear.

short.lead: The redesign is built: a searchable list of projects you can fold, a limits strip along the top, sessions you open on the right with their conversation updating live, and real Claude Code in a panel inside the app. I drove the whole app here with a stand-in for Claude Code, and GitHub's Windows machine passed all tests and built the installer. What's left is your test on your PC with your real sessions.
short.hint: Tap an item to see what was checked and what it needs from you.
items: Title cleaning, search and folding, the limits strip, turning transcripts into messages, the terminal command for each account, and everything from before.
App driven end to end here

Opened a session, clicked Resume here, typed hello and saw it echoed back in the panel, switched to another session and back with the panel still there, started a new session in another project, and saw "Claude Code wasn't found. Install it, then try again." when Claude Code was missing.

items.alt: The app with the alpha session open: its bars, buttons, conversation, and a black terminal panel showing the stand-in Claude Code echoing hello
items.caption: A session open with its terminal panel (stand-in Claude Code).

items: The installer you download from GitHub replaces the version of the app you have now.
Download the installer from the link in my message and unzip it. Then run Project Router Setup 0.1.0.exe. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
The list on the left, the search box and the strip along the top.
Type part of a project or session name into the search box, fold and unfold a project, then click a session and check its conversation matches what you remember.
Work in a session inside the app
Resume here runs your real Claude Code in the panel.
Click Resume here on a session, send Claude a short message, open another session, then come back and check the first one is still there.
The app asks first and names the running sessions.
With a panel still running, close the app and check it asks you, naming that session.

changes: The board is replaced by the list and the open session.
Columns of cards, three bars and two buttons on each.
A folding, searchable list, with the open session on the right.
Sessions older than seven days sit under a folded Older heading. Titles skip text Claude Code inserts on its own.

changes.alt: The new main screen in the demo: limits strip at the top, the project list on the left and an open session with its conversation on the right
changes.caption: The demo with a session open.

changes: Real Claude Code inside the app.

Resume here and New session open Claude Code in a panel on the right account. Switching sessions keeps it running, and closing the app asks first. Open in Windows Terminal is still there as a second button.
You watch and work in one place.
Four automatic saves (commits) credit Claude in their messages.

Automatic saves during this build and the first one made four commits ("wip: autosave") whose messages credit Claude. They are already pushed in the pull request's history, and removing them would mean rewriting that history, so I've left them and I'm telling you here.

wrapup.summary: The redesign is built and checked here and on GitHub's Windows machine.
wrapup.changing: The app and website's main screen. Issues #10 to #13 move to needs review.
